planets.name: WASP-80 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Petra with a 3.07-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-80 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Petra. Its orbit and size follow Triaud et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
